name: prompt2md
description: Enterprise-grade platform and agent skill that converts unstructured text, messy prompts, and complex documents into token-optimized, layout-aware Markdown.

pnpm.comment: Security overrides for transitive deps whose parents have not shipped a patched release yet. Verified against a full build + test run; re-check on dependency bumps. NOT pinned here, deliberately: esbuild and vite. Both advisories (esbuild dev-server request forgery; vite server.fs.deny bypass, optimized-deps .map traversal, launch-editor NTLMv2) only affect a running DEV server, never the built static docs or the deployed app. Their fixes need Vite 6, which means VitePress 2 -- a major upgrade that is a deliberate decision, not a security patch. sharp IS pinned: unlike those, it is an optionalDependency of next and therefore runs in the deployed web app.
